messages:
Alex: Quick micro-handoff from my side — left the cluster autoscaler tweak in prod, scale-down now respects taints again. No ongoing incidents from my shift.
Maria: Thanks Alex — did you update the runbook snippet for the ASG drift check?
Alex: Yep updated the runbook and pushed a tiny PR: `#3456` — mainly added the `kubectl get nodes -l spot=true` step.
Sanjay: Noted. I picked up the noisy 5xx alerts from the inference tier earlier — looks like a memory leak in an older model-serving pod. I restarted the pod and alerted model-ops.
Tess: Which alert fired? I only saw the aggregate error rate spike.
Sanjay: `alert:ModelServingHigh5xxRate` — threshold 0.8% for 5m. PagerDuty incident `PD-1123` opened and auto-resolved after restart.
Alex: Can we add a small mitigator to the playbook: restart only the pod with the highest RSS; avoid rolling restarts if not needed.
Maria: +1. Also can we add a Grafana panel for RSS by pod? That would've made root cause faster.
Sanjay: I can add a quick panel tomorrow. For now I posted the PromQL I used in the incident channel:
```
sum by (pod) (rate(container_memory_rss_bytes{namespace=\"redwood-inference\"}[5m]))
```
Tess: Nice — could we create an alert for sudden RSS growth slope too? e.g., `increase()` over 5m > X.
Alex: One other thing — SLO status: error budget for latency on /v1/generate is 82% remaining for the month but error budget for embeddings is down to 9%. Maria, are we tracking the regression from last week's deploy?
Maria: Yes, working with eng-runtime. There's a canary that's slightly slower due to a quantization change. We flagged it to the model team. Rolling back the quant step on canary reduces p50 by ~30ms.
Sanjay: Suggestion: enable automatic fallback on requests hitting canary if latency > 500ms for 3s window. We have policy to fallback to stable variant.
Tess: I deployed the fallback policy yesterday but it needs the route tag to be present. I added a note in the config repo.
Alex: Blockers for me: need approval on a small Dedicated autoscaler quota bump; pinging finance for cost ok. If anyone is on the finance thread please chime: `@Maria` and `@Sanjay` — just a thumbs up would help.
Maria: I'm on it, will reply in the finance thread.
OncallBot: Reminder: night oncall handoff in 30m for `sre-night`. Pager: `PD-2001` will alert to coverage.
Tess: I'll take night oncall, thanks. Quick ask — could someone verify the nightly backup snapshot completed? The backup check in S3 returned 0 bytes for yesterday.
Sanjay: I checked — backup job `backup-2026-03-16` failed to upload due to transient IAM token expiry. I retried manually and upload succeeded. Logged it in the weekly ops notes.
Alex: Great. No other blockers from me. Good handoff — tag me if anything escalates overnight. :thumbsup:
Maria: Thanks team. Short and actionable. I'll follow up tomorrow with the rollback timeline and the PR for the runbook change. :eyes:
